card.name: Inside Lao script and drug names
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of unfamiliar words: Lao-script syllables, split drug names such as donepezil or PREZISTA, and phonetic spellings. It is most common inside Lao script.

modes.label: Lao script syllables
modes.description: Single characters inside Lao-script words, such as the motto of Laos.
modes.example: ສັນຕິພາບ ເ<<ອ>>ກະລາດ ປ

modes.label: Partway through drug names
modes.description: The middle or end piece of a brand or generic drug name that is split into several pieces.

modes.label: Animal or phonetic spellings
modes.description: Pieces of a species name or a pronunciation guide.
modes.example: omolg<<us>> monkeys during the period of organogenesis resulted

card.plain: It fires inside long or foreign words that are broken into pieces, like Lao script and some drug names.
evidence: omolg<<us>> monkeys during the period of organogenesis resulted
